prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1374; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear bumper cover cracked on the driver side with the trim clip broken away, and the left tail lamp housing shattered. The pattern of scuffing and paint transfer on the bumper fits the low-speed contact described for this parking lot incident. Repair plan is to replace the bumper cover and lamp assembly, refinish the rear panel, and recalibrate the parking sensor. Labor hours line up with the work required for this damage, and the parts and invoices submitted contain no repeated line items. Nothing in the file points to earlier damage on this vehicle at this location.
